problem: Mira Reel was publication-ready but Composio identity preflight used a stale numeric Instagram provider ID.
root_cause: A provider-issued numeric ID was treated as permanent publication identity.
prevention: Discover providerUserId live with INSTAGRAM_GET_USER_INFO(me), require bedrijfsgeheugen.nl plus BUSINESS/CREATOR, and bind create/publish/readback to the same live ID.
failed_approaches: ACTIVE connection metadata without live provider identity readback
